# TaxiD

> Africa's mobility super-platform — ride-hailing, corporate mobility, package delivery and car rentals on one enterprise-grade stack built for African cities.

TaxiD operates a multi-product mobility network across Kenya and expanding African markets. The platform serves individual riders, driver-partners, corporate travel managers, delivery senders, and rental customers, with M-Pesa, card and corporate-wallet payments.

## Pages

- [About](/about): Company mission, leadership and Africa-wide footprint.
- [Riders](/riders): Booking rides, vehicle tiers, safety and payment options.
- [Drivers](/drivers): Driver-partner earnings, requirements and onboarding.
- [Corporates](/corporates): Corporate mobility, dual wallets and KRA-compliant invoicing.
- [Delivery](/delivery): Same-day and scheduled package delivery with POD.
- [Rentals](/rentals): Self-drive, chauffeur, bus/coach and corporate leasing.
- [Enterprise](/enterprise): White-label dispatch, fleet and payments infrastructure.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Fares, surge caps and corporate plans.
- [Developers](/developers): Public APIs, SDKs and sandbox.
- [Security Centre](/security): Security, privacy and compliance posture.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions for riders, drivers and corporates.
- [Support](/support): Help centre and contact channels.
- [Careers](/careers): Open roles across engineering, operations and design.
- [News](/news): Press releases and product updates.
- [Contact](/contact): Sales, support and partnership enquiries.
- [Corporate Travel Guide](/blog/corporate-travel-management-guide): Practical guide for finance and HR teams.
